page.content:
Abyss below the Underworld where Titans and the worst dead are bound.

How Tartarus connects

  • Faction: Titans — Most Titans were imprisoned in Tartarus after the Titanomachy.
  • Location: Underworld — Tartarus lies beneath the halls of the dead.

What is Tartarus?

Tartarus is the pit beneath Hades' realm, a prison for the Titans after the Titanomachy and a place of punishment deeper than the halls of the dead.

Key threads lead to Titans and Underworld.
